title: R5B E2A 12FP COLD T5  ·  RELEASED TO DATE
plan: R5B 4FP POB LUMENTUM SUB ASSEMBLY - E2A
howto: SAP COOIS export (new_e2a) run on the 14 E2A assy codes, all orders released to date (20-Apr-26 to 03-Oct-26). 691 work orders, 1 EA each. Each SAP Order number is a WO on the 'Work Orders' tab.
Release per repeater from the kitting plan × 13 repeaters (1–13). Example: erbium spool 24 × 13 = 312.
SAP system status → dashboard: DLV (delivered) = Delivered · CNF/PCNF (confirmed / partly confirmed) = In Progress · REL only = Released. The full SAP status is kept in the Remarks column.
COVERED = WOs released match the contract qty · OVER = more WOs than the 13-repeater qty (check for scrap/re-work replacements) · SHORT n = n units still to release · NO WO = nothing released.
Full repeater sets released = the lowest number of complete repeaters across all 14 codes. 'Fully delivered' does the same using delivered WOs only.
WOs released but not yet delivered (Released + In Progress). These are the ones to chase.
'Latest WO' shows the newest order number per code. For the full list filter column B on 'Work Orders'.
Pick a repeater 1–13 in the pink cell to see the per-repeater requirement (default qty) against an even share of released WOs.
Add new COOIS orders at the bottom of 'Work Orders': WO No., Assy Code, Qty Override = order qty (1), Status. Or send the new export and it can be reloaded.
Open the Dashboard tab and press Ctrl+F1 to hide the ribbon. It fits one landscape screen.
